# 流动渐变网格

几团柔和的彩色光晕缓慢漂移融合，最流行的高级感渐变背景。

来源：https://github.com/xiyu519/MotionVault/blob/0a201da92e4b4fa7436b1c79c7f249bc66329644/src/components/effects/background/GradientMesh.tsx

版本：0a201da92e4b4fa7436b1c79c7f249bc66329644

许可：MIT（保留上游 LICENSE）

触发：auto

## 原始实现提示词

Create a React gradient-mesh background: four large radial-gradient color
blobs (#C7D2FE, #FBCFE8, #A7F3D0, #FDE68A, ~45% radius) drifting along
slow elliptical paths (periods 18/23/29/31s), blurred 60px, blended with
mix-blend-mode multiply over a white base. Pure CSS keyframes, GPU-friendly
(transform only). Use as an absolute inset-0 -z-10 page background.
